PdfCraft foundation test build for the ODIBO PDF project

This is an unsigned engineering test build, not an official PdfCraft or ODIBO PDF release.
The application and executable names remain PdfCraft at this stage. ArtCraft trademark
images and affiliation wording are excluded by the ui-egui/unbranded build feature.
PDF functions, including OCR, have not been removed. Upstream links are retained as
links to the upstream community, not as a promise of support or endorsement of this build.

Extract the entire GitHub Actions artifact to a writable folder and run pdfcraft.exe.
Keep models/, licences/, THIRD_PARTY_CARGO.html, NOTICE, attribution and licence files together.
portable.txt keeps settings and recovery data in PdfCraftData next to the executables.
This stage retains the upstream application IDs, installer publisher and update endpoint;
those are on the next stage's rebranding checklist. No installer or official release is included.

Original copyright and licence terms remain in LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE, NOTICE,
ATTRIBUTION.md and the accompanying licence files. New foundation code uses the same
MIT OR Apache-2.0 terms. OCR models have their own attribution and CC BY-SA 4.0 licences
in models/. No ownership of upstream code, fonts or models is claimed.

BUILD_INFO.txt identifies the source commit. SHA256SUMS.txt covers the included files.
The GitHub Actions download is a ZIP; sign in to GitHub to download it within seven days.
